svg.title: A deadline time, from four keyboards to five consumers

g.text: A deadline time, from four keyboards to five consumers

g.id: cluster_Domain — the only place the invariant lives
g.text: Domain — the only place the invariant lives
An orphan time is dropped, not stored.
"17:00, no date" is not a deadline, it is a
half-typed one — and storing it would force
every consumer downstream to invent its own
the field costs the wire nothing extra
